ideas.pitch: An intelligent tech stack recommendation engine with architectural reasoning and automated constraint mapping.
ideas.problem_statement: Overview Engineer an Intelligent Tech Stack Recommendation Engine! Participants must engineer an engine that processes project parameters—including scale, team size, budget, and infrastructure constraints—and outputs an optimal combination of frontend, backend, database, and hosting tools.
ideas.title: StackPulse AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns directly with the sole core requirement of the StackSense Challenge by providing rigorous architectural reasoning and edge-case handling for a clean PDF project report.
